_description: Formula Bharat Impact Attenuator Optimizer — Engineering Knowledge Base v1.0

materials.name: CFRP
materials.role: Face sheet — structural integrity and load distribution
materials.notes: High stiffness, low SEA. Used as face sheet to distribute load evenly.

materials.name: Honeycomb
materials.role: Primary energy absorber — highest SEA material
materials.notes: Dominant energy absorber. Low density with exceptional SEA. Core of attenuator stack.

materials.name: Al Foam
materials.notes: Higher density than honeycomb. Stable plateau stress. Good for rear section.

materials.name: PU Foam
materials.role: Tertiary absorber — low-speed impact and vibration damping
materials.notes: Good SEA-to-density ratio. Progressive behaviour. Acts as compliance layer.

vehicle.description: Typical Formula Student vehicle total mass including driver

design_constraints.source: Formula Bharat 2024 Technical Regulations — Impact Attenuator Section

scoring_weights.description: Higher score = better design. Penalises deviation from targets and unsafe designs.

formula_bharat_rules_reference.section: T3 — Impact Attenuator and Anti-Intrusion Plate
key_requirements: Must absorb minimum 7350 J (EV: 7350 J minimum)
Average deceleration ≤ 20 g over crush distance
Peak deceleration ≤ 40 g at any point
Must be mounted ahead of anti-intrusion plate
Minimum cross section 100mm × 100mm at vehicle attachment
formula_bharat_rules_reference.note: Verify against current year's official regulations before competition submission
